items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: The guy said, look we have Sonny Stitt in the house, he's going to come up and play a couple of numbers.

ctx.x: Yeah. But they didn't call it, just you called a guy to sit in. It wasn't like you're hiring somebody for a jam session. He didn't announce it was a jam session. The guy said, look we have Sonny Stitt in the house, he's going to come up and play a couple of numbers.
So Ray was invited over. What did you think about him?
